world.title: Meet Jonathan Yan, the 18-year-old California student who studied 479 human cancer cell lines; when he blocked one highly active pathway, the cancer cells stopped spreading
world.summary: Eighteen-year-old Jonathan Yan from Irvine, California, conducted research on 479 human cancer cell lines. He successfully halted the spread of cancer cells by blocking the transsulfuration pathway. This work was part of his computational biology and bioinformatics project. Yan's findings contribute to understanding cancer cell behavior and potential therapeutic approaches for cancer treatment.

world.title: Texas wants to ban H-1Bs in public schools, Guv Greg Abbott says there should be no foreign indoctrination in the classrooms
world.summary: Texas Governor Greg Abbott aims to ban H-1B hiring in public schools, citing concerns over foreign influence, particularly from China and Islamic ideologies. In January, he initiated a freeze on H-1B employment at public higher education institutions. This move reflects Abbott's stance against what he describes as foreign indoctrination in classrooms, emphasizing the need for domestic educational integrity.

world.title: What Changes For Indian Applicants
world.summary: Starting September 18, changes to the US public charge rule will impact green card applicants, including Indian applicants. The new guidelines clarify that no single factor, aside from an insufficient Affidavit of Support, can solely determine public charge likelihood. Additionally, receipt of means-tested public benefits will not automatically disqualify applicants, outlining key eligibility factors and exemptions.

business.title: Growth in core sectors slows to 5.4% in July 2026
business.summary: India's core sectors recorded a growth rate of 5.4% in July 2026, a decline from 6% in June. This slowdown, noted in official data released on August 20, 2026, marks the second-fastest growth in seven months. Key contributors to the slowdown included significant reductions in the fertilisers and iron ore sectors, impacting overall economic activity.

business.title: First Kia Sorento Hybrid SUV Rolls Out Of India Plant - Production Starts
business.summary: Kia has officially unveiled the Sorento Hybrid SUV in India, with local production commencing ahead of its launch on September 4. The Sorento joins India's large SUV segment, which includes both monocoque and ladder frame vehicles. This premium SUV will serve as Kia's flagship internal combustion engine (ICE) offering in the Indian market, enhancing the company's portfolio.

business.title: Zombie Card Attack Can Revive Expired Visa Cards for Contactless Payments
business.summary: Researchers at the University of Massachusetts Amherst have unveiled a method called "Zombie Card" that can revive expired Visa contactless credit cards. By rewriting the expiration date transmitted to point-of-sale terminals, the attack enables real in-store purchases without compromising card cryptography. This technique was successfully tested at a U.S. bank, raising concerns about the security of contactless payments.

technology.title: Apple iPhone 18 Pro Could Get Game-Changing 2nm Chip Upgrade
technology.summary: Apple's upcoming iPhone 18 Pro may feature a significant internal upgrade with a new chip utilizing a 2nm manufacturing process. This advancement is expected to enhance performance and efficiency, marking one of the most substantial improvements in recent years. While details remain unconfirmed by Apple, industry reports suggest this upgrade could redefine the device's capabilities.

technology.title: screen candybar phone: 1.05 mm bezels, 7,000mAh battery, 6.68mm thickness
technology.summary: Huawei has launched the Pura X View smartphone featuring a 6.39" OLED display with a 16:9.5 aspect ratio and a resolution of 2232 × 1320. The device boasts 1.05 mm bezels, a thickness of 6.68 mm, and a substantial 7,000mAh battery. This model introduces a wider screen experience to the smartphone market, enhancing user interaction.

technology.title: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 Update Release Times Revealed for All Regions, Full Schedule
technology.summary: Fortnite Chapter 7 Season 4 is set to launch, attracting significant player interest. The update's release times vary by region, and players are advised to approach claims regarding exact worldwide timings with caution. Typically, Epic Games releases updates simultaneously across the globe. Players are encouraged to stay informed about the schedule to ensure they are ready for the new season.

sports.title: No pigeons, no monkeys. BWF praises Delhi for turning it around after India Open row
sports.summary: The BWF World Championships at Delhi's IGI Stadium have received praise from BWF chief Thomas Lund and players, marking a significant turnaround from the criticism faced during the India Open. Seven months after disruptions caused by birds and a monkey, the venue has improved its conditions, leading to a positive atmosphere at the ongoing championships.

sports.title: Mohun Bagan vs NorthEast United LIVE score: MBSG 0-0 NEUFC; Sahal, Ajaraie start in Durand Cup 2026 semifinal
sports.summary: Mohun Bagan Super Giant (MBSG) and NorthEast United FC (NEUFC) are currently facing off in the Durand Cup 2026 semifinal in Shillong. The match remains scoreless at 0-0. Players Sahal and Ajaraie have started for MBSG. Live updates are being provided as the game progresses. The match is being closely followed by fans and analysts alike.

sports.title: Sam Curran ruled out of English summer due to groin injury
sports.summary: England all-rounder Sam Curran has been ruled out for the remainder of the summer due to a groin injury. Surrey confirmed that he will undergo surgery on August 21. Additionally, teammate Will Jacks is recovering from an operation to remove his appendix. This injury marks a significant setback for Curran, impacting his availability for upcoming matches.

health.title: Meet Jonathan Yan, the 18-year-old California student who studied 479 human cancer cell lines; when he blocked one highly active pathway, the cancer cells stopped spreading
health.summary: Eighteen-year-old Jonathan Yan from Irvine, California, conducted research on 479 human cancer cell lines as part of his computational biology project. He successfully halted the spread of cancer cells by blocking the transsulfuration pathway. His findings contribute to understanding cancer cell behavior and potential therapeutic approaches, showcasing the impact of young researchers in the field of cancer biology.

health.title: Heatwaves And Health Risks Increase
health.summary: Heatwaves are raising health risks, particularly for older adults and individuals with chronic conditions, as reported by the WHO. Extreme heat is contributing to a rise in heat-related illnesses and deaths, putting additional strain on healthcare services. Vulnerable populations are increasingly affected, with heat stress exacerbating cardiovascular issues and other health problems.

health.title: Flight crew face highest radiation cancer risk: study
health.summary: A recent study indicates that flight attendants and pilots have the highest risk of dying from radiation-related cancers among over 500 US occupations examined. This risk surpasses that of workers who directly handle radioactive materials. The findings highlight the potential health hazards associated with prolonged exposure to cosmic radiation during flights, raising concerns about occupational safety in the aviation industry.

science.title: MIT engineers built a small room-temperature device that generates paired radio waves; a message encoded in one signal could be decoded only with its matching partner
science.summary: MIT engineers have developed a small, room-temperature device that generates paired radio waves, allowing messages encoded in one signal to be decoded only with its matching partner. This advancement in quantum technology could significantly enhance secure communication methods. The device utilizes magnetic film, addressing a major challenge in the field and potentially transforming information transmission, detection, and protection.

science.title: Discovery of 'Mega-Earth' GJ 523b Challenges Planetary Formation Theories
science.summary: Astronomers have discovered GJ 523b, a dense 'mega-Earth' with 23 times the mass of Earth, which challenges current planetary formation theories. Its unique rocky composition may result from atmospheric stripping or giant impacts. This finding enhances the understanding of unusual exoplanets and raises questions about the processes involved in their formation and evolution in the universe.

entertainment.title: Awarapan 2 Box Office Collection Day 6 Updates: Emraan Hashmi film crosses Rs 150 crore mark
entertainment.summary: Awarapan 2, starring Emraan Hashmi, has surpassed the Rs 150 crore mark at the box office within six days of its release. The film has grossed Rs 128.29 crore in India, with a net collection of Rs 107.50 crore. Its total worldwide earnings stand at Rs 153.59 crore, reflecting a strong performance in both domestic and international markets.

entertainment.title: Mallika Sherawat tells Shweta Tiwari she will set her up with a European man, says they are far better than Indian men
entertainment.summary: Mallika Sherawat and Shweta Tiwari, participants in The Traitors Season 2, have developed a friendship during the show. In a recent episode, Sherawat suggested she could introduce Tiwari to a European man, claiming they are superior to Indian men. The season features Dalip Tahil, who recently joined the group of innocents after an early exit.

entertainment.title: Internet loves the softer side of Kangana Ranaut as she blushes after being called ‘sundar’
entertainment.summary: Kangana Ranaut, known for her controversial statements, recently showcased a softer side when she blushed after being called 'sundar' (beautiful). The actor and BJP MP was last seen in the film Bharat Bhhagya Vidhhaata, directed by Manoj Tapadia. Her reaction has garnered attention on social media, highlighting a different aspect of her public persona.
